## berth ui

the web dashboard, in your browser

### Synopsis

Serves berth's web dashboard on this machine and opens it in your browser: every org and host
with its state, and a page per org with its connection sheet, firewall, repos, variable names,
packages, backups and log. It does what `berth tui` does, through the same operations.

It listens on 127.0.0.1 only, on a port of its own, and every request needs a token made for
this run: it is in the link berth prints, kept nowhere, and gone when berth ui ends. Anything
that restarts a container says what stops and runs only after the org's name is typed. With
--read-only it only reads. It runs until interrupted.

From another device, use `berth serve --listen` and a token (docs/guides/web.md).

Docs: https://ar4mirez.github.io/berth/reference/commands/berth_ui/

```
berth ui [--port N] [--no-open] [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  berth ui
  berth --read-only ui
  berth ui --port 7780 --no-open
```

### Options

```
  -h, --help       help for ui
      --no-open    print the link and don't open a browser
      --port int   the port on 127.0.0.1 to listen on (default: any free one)
```

      --home string              state root (default: $BERTH_HOME, then home: in config.yaml, then ~/.local/share/berth)
